risks.risk: Corrosion or pitting at the neck/collar could indicate structural weakness or a leak point.
risks.proof: A sharp, well-lit close-up of the collar and valve threads from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible corrosion, i.e. below a clean/rust-free example

risks.risk: No visible manufacture date or hydrostatic re-test stamp, which determines if the cylinder is legally fillable/safe.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped date/test ring on the collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown test status, i.e. may need re-certification before use

risks.risk: Valve may be worn, stuck, or leaking.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve being turned, plus a soapy-water leak test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e. as if valve needs replacement

risks.risk: Actual capacity may differ from the claimed 50kg (could be 40kg or other common size).
risks.proof: Close-up of the stamped water capacity (WC) marking on the collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smaller/common size until confirmed

risks.risk: Cylinder could be empty, partially filled, or the seller's right to resell an industrial gas asset unverified.
risks.proof: Not resolvable remotely; irrelevant to cylinder hardware price but worth a buyer question.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the collar stamp showing capacity (WC), manufacture date, and last hydrostatic test date.
Close-up/video of the valve being opened and closed, plus a leak check.
Photo of the base area showing any manufacturer or safety markings.
Wider, well-lit photo of the entire cylinder body for a full condition check.
response.reason: This is a generic, unbranded 50kg-claimed gas cylinder with visible rust and wear and no legible safety or capacity markings, so it must be priced at worst case (uncertain capacity, unverified valve, unknown test date) until the requested close-ups are supplied.
